Starred Questions

Monsoon Session 2022
STARRED QUESTION NO. 12 Subject: Infrastructure Development in North-East India Asked by: SHRI PRIYANKA CHATURVEDI SHRI NITIN GADKARI MINISTER OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS : The government has invested heavily in north-east infrastructure. A total of 1200 km of roads have been built. SHRI PRIYANKA CHATURVEDI : I would like to ask a supplementary question. What is the timeline for completion? SHRI NITIN GADKARI MINISTER OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS : The completion is expected by 2025. All projects are on track. SHRI DEREK O'BRIEN : Further to the supplementary, I wish to raise the issue of connectivity. SHRI NITIN GADKARI MINISTER OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS : The connectivity issue is being addressed through the Sagarmala project.
